question.text: The maximum permissible leverage for a Category III AIF is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Per page 124 of the workbook, SEBI caps Category III AIF leverage at 2 times NAV, computed as Total Exposure (Long + Short after permitted offsetting) divided by NAV. Page 278 corroborates the 2x NAV cap in the context of derivative leverage. The Trap: 1x and 1.5x are below the cap, and 3x exceeds it. Note: The leverage ratio must be monitored on an ongoing basis against the 2x NAV cap.
